body.x: PLATFORMBASE will participate in the world's largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its ICT smart Digital Locking system.
Platformbase Co., Ltd. specializes in physical security solutions based on digital locking device and is line-up with a converged technology and business model.

This technology holds a number of nationally recognized certifications such as New Technology Certification (NET) and patents in Korea, USA, Europe and China, and has been recognized by the national government such as Prime Minister's Award and Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy.

Platform Base Co., Ltd. implements the same size as the existing mechanical lock to eliminate the limitation of installation, and solves the existing problem of security / management / convenience / control by granting ICT function.

Its size is made smaller than the existing mechanical locks, so it has a wide range of applications. Because of no battery in the lock, there is no risk of explosion, it can be used in the main facility storage. In addition, it is an eco-friendly product that reduces the cost and management process associated with battery replacement and eliminates waste battery discharge. The usage history is stored, and multiple locks can be used with one key to facilitate the management work, and the control system can be constructed by remotely monitoring the use and authorizing the access with real-time communication function.

The official said, "Our overseas business development strategy consists of three steps. 1. Targeting European market with clear precautionary measures in security, safety and management 2. Expanding Asian market based on Korean and Japanese market 3. Looking to enter America market through this CES. Our partners are specialists with security / system / sales capabilities in each country."
He continued, "We plan to strengthen marketing to attract new customers as well as existing customers, and to increase references through domestic and overseas specialized companies."

The world's largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
